GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 684 (22 Mar 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 833)
APO 500
22 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Aerial Gunnery Ranges.
1. The following water areas have been approved by the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers for use by the occupational air forces as aerial gunnery ranges:
Hokkaido Area: (42゜05' N, 141゜40' E) (42゜20' N, 141゜50' E)
(42゜10' N, 142゜20' E) (41゜55' N, 142゜10' E)
Honshu Area (36゜00' N, 140゜55' E) (36゜00' N, 141゜20' E)
(36゜30' N, 140゜55' E) (36゜30' N, 141゜20' E)
Kyushu Area (34゜10' N, 130゜20' E) (34゜10' N, 130゜40' E)
(34゜40' N, 130゜20' E) (34゜40' N, 130゜40' E)
2. You will notify all Japanese agencies concerned that all surface craft will remain out of the above areas after 1 April 1946, except when specific authority has been granted by the commanders indicated in paragraph 3 below.
3. Requests by Governors of Prefectures concerned to allow fishing in range areas when not in use will be honored by local Air Force Commanders in charge of gunnery ranges, as follows:
Hokkaido Area : Commandimg Officer, Chitose Army Air Base.
Honshu Area : Commanding General, Fifth Bomber Command, Johnson Field, Irumagawa.
Kyushu Area : Commanding General, Fifth Fighter Command, Itazuki Army Air Base.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
